## What was copied

Unmodified at that commit, under `upstream/`:

- `SKILL.md`, `README.md`, `README_en.md`, `ROADMAP.md`, `LICENSE`, `meta_skill_memory.json`, `.gitignore`
- `tools/`, `prompts/`, `references/`, `.github/`
- `prototypes/short-video-ads-master/` only

`SKILL.md` in this folder (next to this file) is the Amazon / short-video usage wrapper written for this repository. It is not part of the upstream project.

## What was not copied

Eighty other directories under upstream `prototypes/`. They are generated industry samples and are not required to run the generator. Names are listed in `OMITTED_PROTOTYPES.txt`. That includes `amazon-operating-model-master`, `cross-border-ecommerce-master`, `douyin-live-commerce-master`, and `ad-agency-performance-master`.

The kept prototype `short-video-ads-master` is a partial sample whose own intake says the industry is China-platform short-video paid ads (巨量引擎 / 千川). It is not an Amazon diagnostic product.
